verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents rule-based card authorization controls and spend controls that enforce policy, plus webhooks for real-time event notifications and AgentOS, which lets AI agents act on the production account by reading data and building reports. A user could assemble AI-driven review from these pieces, but nothing in the evidence shows built-in AI anomaly or out-of-policy flagging. Missing for 10: native AI anomaly detection, automatic flagging of out-of-policy transactions into a review queue, documentation of an agent workflow for transaction review, and independent corroboration.
